transcript.text:
Thank you all for flagging these issues. Let me make sure I understand what we're dealing with before I make any decisions.

Riley, on rights: the option agreement authorizes exactly 8 episodes, not 10, and requires the title credit to read 'Based on the novel by Celia Voss.' Your rights memo hasn't formally circulated yet.

Samir, on sound: the distribution platform requires stereo at 48 kHz with mono compatibility, and will reject binaural outright. That spec hasn't made it into the greenlight packet yet.

Jo, on talent: both principals are available jointly only August 12-14, and their agreement requires joint recording sessions. Those dates aren't on the studio calendar yet.

So we have three conflicts with the draft production plan: episode count (8 vs. 10), audio format (stereo/48kHz/mono-compatible vs. binaural), and recording sessions (joint on Aug 12-14 vs. separate remote sessions). All three need to be resolved before I can approve this package.

Before I settle, I need each of you to formally reveal your findings so they're on the record. Riley, please reveal your rights findings. Samir, please reveal the sound delivery spec. Jo, please reveal the scheduling constraint. Once all three are formally disclosed, I'll make the binding decisions on the production package.
